name: Atlanta Electricals Ltd
title: Atlanta Electricals Ltd - 544527 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 81.7% YoY to INR747.6 cr with EBITDA margin near 20%, but Vadod ran at ~39% utilisation and management is preparing a capex-led EHV build-out with working-capital needs rising to 80-90 days.

utilisation.quote: unit four operated at approximately 39% of the nameplate capacity, which is 30,000 MVA

capex.peers_comment: Management said capacity expansion across manufacturers is 'to meet the demand generation' and that industry capacity 'is going to still fall short of the requirement'.
capex.quote: whatever amount of capacity Indian manufacturers are going to put up, it is going to still fall short of the requirement

triggers.label: Vadod utilisation 39% → 65% target FY27
triggers.quote: We expect it to be 65% in this particular year and then eventually taking it to 100% in the next financial year.

triggers.label: IDT + tank/radiator capex INR245-250 cr
triggers.quote: for IDT it is around INR65 crores of capex and for backward integration, it is INR170 to INR180 crores of the capex.

triggers.label: ~75% of order book has price variation clause
triggers.quote: Approximately 75% of the order is on with the price variation clause

triggers.label: Year-end inventory drawn down, 'planned' per management
triggers.quote: inventory was deliberately drawn down in March end to facilitate those maintenance windows smoothly.

triggers.label: Order book INR2,493 cr; orders INR2,507 cr in FY26
triggers.quote: Team Atlanta booked INR2,507 crores of new order during FY26, which elevated our unexecuted order book on 31st March 2026 to INR2,493 crores

guidance.quote: we would be growing at about 40% CAGR for next 3 years
we maintain a standard that it's going to be stable
We expect it to be 65% in this particular year and then eventually taking it to 100% in the next financial year.
our net working capital days will go up around 80s and 90s
in next 3 years' time, we have this target of taking our exports to 15% of the total revenue

prior_guidance_check.quote: comfortably ahead of the 40% growth trajectory targeted we had set for the year
We expect it to be like we suggested before going public, about 35% in the last financial year, which is about 39%.
As of 31st March '26, the closing balance on all term loans is nil.

red_flags.label: Working-capital days to rise from ~64 to 80-90
red_flags.quote: our net working capital days will go up around 80s and 90s

red_flags.label: Year-end inventory drawdown described as planned
red_flags.quote: On the year-end inventory position, I would like to confirm that it was a planned decision.

red_flags.label: Non-PVC ~25% of order book exposed to commodity cost
red_flags.quote: rest of the orders are without price variation clause

red_flags.label: OIP bushing supply issues
red_flags.quote: We are seeing in particular supply issues on the OIP bushings

evasions.topic: Data-centre order size and count of active inquiries
evasions.quote: We do not have any fixed numbers or specific numbers to tell you at this moment.
It would not be fair on our part to maybe commit or comment as to which markets we are approaching
it's quite early for us to comment on that
